Self.Wiki: Weather lot region (formerly Weather Override; managed by the game's CSWeatherLotRegionMan). While the player is inside it, each field that is not -1 overrides the map's value. Where regions overlap, the first matching region wins, field by field.

WeatherLotParamID.Wiki: The WeatherLotParam row used inside the region. -1: no override.

UnkT04.Wiki: An override kept by the weather manager; -1 = none. Always -1 in retail; what reads it was not found.

ApplyMimicryLotLimitSpEffect0.Wiki: Overrides MimicryEstablishmentTexParam isApplyMimicryLotLimitSpEffect0 inside the region. -1: no override, 0: off, 1: on.

ApplyMimicryLotLimitSpEffect1.Wiki: Overrides MimicryEstablishmentTexParam isApplyMimicryLotLimitSpEffect1 inside the region. -1: no override, 0: off, 1: on.

ApplyMimicryLotLimitSpEffect2.Wiki: Overrides MimicryEstablishmentTexParam isApplyMimicryLotLimitSpEffect2 inside the region. -1: no override, 0: off, 1: on.

UnkT0B.Wiki: 0 in retail; never read by the game.
